source_policy.fallback_rule: GitHub/yfinance, FinMind and TAIFEX may fill null fields only when the observation belongs to the same specified trade date/session date. Never silently overwrite a non-null canonical value or use a different trade date.
source_policy.trade_date_rule: Monday pre-open report: latest completed U.S. cash session is Friday 2026-08-28. Taiwan cash/FX/OI latest completed session is 2026-08-28. TAIFEX after-hours physical window 2026-08-28 15:00–2026-08-29 05:00 is attributed to session_trade_date 2026-08-31.
source_policy.uncertainty_rule: When exact same-session data are not independently verified, retain null or flag validation_required. Different-date values must never be blended or silently overwritten.

taiwan_futures.note: TAIFEX official after-hours report shows OI as '-' for this session. Do not label regular-session OI as night-session OI.

breaking_news.headline: Warsh hawkish repricing carries into global markets
breaking_news.summary: Sunday Gulf markets fell as investors carried forward higher Fed-hike odds after Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole inflation warning.
breaking_news.market_impact: Higher-for-longer rate risk remains the dominant valuation headwind entering Monday.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: High-duration AI and semiconductor names remain sensitive to yields despite strong earnings fundamentals.

breaking_news.headline: U.S. to refill Strategic Petroleum Reserve with Venezuelan oil
breaking_news.summary: President Trump said oil from a new Venezuela agreement will be used to begin refilling the U.S. SPR, recently near a multi-decade low.
breaking_news.market_impact: Adds a medium-term U.S. crude demand channel while Hormuz/Iran risks keep the energy complex geopolitically sensitive.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Energy and shipping pricing remain two-sided: SPR demand support versus potential Venezuelan supply recovery.

breaking_news.headline: G20 opens under tariffs, Iran war and bond-market stress
breaking_news.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent heads into the Asheville G20 amid trade friction, Iran-related commerce disruption, U.S. debt concerns and elevated long-term yields.
breaking_news.market_impact: Keeps tariffs, fiscal credibility, FX policy and long-bond volatility in focus.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: Semiconductor tariff headlines and Asian FX volatility remain key external risks.

breaking_news.headline: European central bankers flag turbulence in U.S. financial relations
breaking_news.summary: European officials voiced concern about unpredictability around U.S. currency actions and financial cooperation after recent yen intervention.
breaking_news.market_impact: Raises tail-risk attention around FX intervention and dollar-liquidity coordination.
breaking_news.taiwan_impact: A renewed yen shock can spill into Asian currencies and foreign investor positioning.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Weekend setup: AI fundamentals strong, but chip leadership is rate-sensitive
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: No newer verified cash-market print exists after 2026-08-28. Nvidia fell 4.57%, AMD 2.33% and TSM ADR 2.29% Friday as yields rose, leaving the AI trade dependent on this week's infrastructure earnings and jobs data.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: The next confirmation must come from breadth and AI infrastructure demand, not Nvidia earnings alone.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Use U.S. sector rotation plus Taiwan local rotation before extrapolating to TSMC, server ODM, PCB, cooling and power names.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: AI investment gains are becoming a reported-profit quality issue
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Financial Times reported large valuation gains on stakes in AI companies have boosted reported profits at major technology groups including Microsoft peers, complicating comparison of core operating earnings.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Investors may differentiate recurring AI revenue from mark-to-market investment gains more aggressively.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Hardware demand read-through should focus on capex and deployment rather than headline net income.

ai_semiconductor_news.headline: Friday leadership diverged from semiconductors
ai_semiconductor_news.summary: Apple rose 1.63% and Microsoft 1.68% on 2026-08-28 while Nvidia, AMD and TSM ADR fell.
ai_semiconductor_news.market_impact: Megacap leadership broadened away from chips, cushioning the indexes.
ai_semiconductor_news.taiwan_impact: Consumer-device and enterprise-AI exposures may offset some semiconductor beta.

narration_points: 最新完整美股交易日仍是8月28日：標普跌0.25%、那斯達克跌0.52%、Russell 2000跌1.39%，道瓊近乎持平。
Warsh偏鷹訊號持續主導跨資產：10年期美債約4.72%、美元指數約99.68；COMEX十二月黃金收4529.90美元、跌2.88%，WTI約83.42美元。
半導體明顯弱於大盤：SOX跌3.47%，NVIDIA跌4.57%，TSM ADR跌2.29%，AMD跌2.33%；Apple與Microsoft逆勢上漲，顯示資金開始從晶片向其他大型科技分化。
台指期最新夜盤是8月28日15點至8月29日5點、歸屬8月31日，近月收45,900點、跌457點或0.99%；官方夜盤表的OI欄為空，不能把日盤OI冒充夜盤OI。
過去24小時新增風險集中在政策與能源：美國將以委內瑞拉原油補充SPR，G20面臨關稅、伊朗戰事、債市與匯率政策壓力。
本週主線由NVIDIA財報切換到就業週與AI基建財報：9月1日JOLTS，9月4日非農；Dell與Broadcom將驗證AI伺服器、網通與客製ASIC需求。
